question: What is the wildest thing that ever happened at your school?
story: Our entire school shut down for two days because of one chicken nobody could catch. Somebody, and to this day nobody knows who, released a live chicken into the west hallway on a Tuesday morning. Our principal treated it like a national emergency. He canceled fourth period and organized a search party of volunteer students, which was the worst decision of his career. We did not want to catch that chicken. We wanted to protect it. We named her Deborah. Kids hid her in lockers, passed her between classes, and fed her cafeteria corn. She stayed on the run for thirty one hours. The custodian finally found her in the band room, sitting inside a tuba. Here is the best part. The principal was so defeated that he let the agriculture teacher keep her. Deborah lived on school grounds for four more years. She outlasted the principal.
